A2_hybrid_reranker.architecture: Hybrid BM25 + Dense + RRF + Cross-Encoder Reranker
A2_hybrid_reranker.retrieval: dense + BM25 hybrid with reciprocal rank fusion

A3_parent_child.retrieval: dense child retrieval with parent expansion

A4_parent_child_hybrid_rerank.architecture: Parent-Child + Hybrid BM25/Dense + RRF + Cross-Encoder Reranker
A4_parent_child_hybrid_rerank.retrieval: dense + BM25 hybrid with reciprocal rank fusion and parent expansion

A5_hyde_multi_query.architecture: HyDE + Multi-Query Expansion + Hybrid Retrieval + Reranker
A5_hyde_multi_query.retrieval: original hybrid retrieval + HyDE dense retrieval + multi-query hybrid retrieval + RRF
A5_hyde_multi_query.note: Pilot evaluation on first 10 queries due to LLM cost and runtime.

notes: A2 achieved the highest Hit Rate@3. A4 is recommended for production-style RAG because it preserves richer parent-level context while maintaining near-best retrieval accuracy. RAGAS was run as a small pilot due to API cost.
